stem: An architect wishes to investigate whether the buildings in a certain city are higher, on average, than buildings in other cities. He takes a large random sample of buildings from the city and finds the mean height of the buildings in the sample. He calculates the value of the test statistic, $z$, and finds that $z = 2.41$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain briefly whether he should use a one-tail test or a two-tail test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Carry out the test at the 1% significance level.
